header.description: What {org} pays Oxagen. Your agents' own model and tool spend is on the Spend page; the two are kept apart on purpose.

checkout.success: Checkout finished. The governed action units you bought are added to the bucket once Stripe confirms the payment.
checkout.cancel: Checkout was cancelled. Nothing was charged.
checkout.credits: Checkout finished. The usage credits you bought are added to the balance once Stripe confirms the payment.
checkout.plan: Checkout finished. The new plan applies once Stripe confirms the subscription.

tiles.label: This month at a glance
tiles.dueNote: {count, plural, one {# open invoice} other {# open invoices}} · {currency}
tiles.mixedCurrency: open invoices in more than one currency

thisMonth.title: This month

basis.invoices: {count, plural, =0 {no invoices} one {# invoice} other {# invoices}}
basis.tax: added by Stripe on each invoice, not itemised here
basis.total: the lines above, as Stripe invoiced them

thisMonth.empty: Nothing billed yet this month. The free tier is every feature and {count} GAU a month.
thisMonth.partial: This month continues on the next page of invoices, so the total covers this page only.
thisMonth.mixedCurrency: invoices in more than one currency

meters.title: Meters
meters.gauNote: {period} · {remaining} · resolve_approval is the only billable governed action, one GAU each
meters.creditsNote: balance for in-app AI usage; 1 credit = $0.01
meters.exhaustedNoCard: <link>Add a payment method</link> to keep governing this month, or your allowance renews on {date}

mode.prepaid: Prepaid — governed actions stop when the bucket is empty unless auto top-up refills it
mode.prepaidNoCard: Prepaid — governed actions stop when the bucket is empty unless auto top-up refills it — add a payment method to keep governing past the allowance, or wait for the next month
mode.invoice: Invoice billing — usage is never capped; overage is invoiced at period end, or once {max} governed action units accrue
mode.pastDue: Payment past due: an interim or period-close invoice is open. Governing continues; pay it from Invoices.

priceList.title: The price list
priceList.bands: Volume bands, per 1,000 GAU by annual volume
priceList.callsTerms: provider cost times the meter markup
priceList.everyFeature: Every feature is on for every tier.

autoTopup.title: Auto top-up
autoTopup.enabled: Top up automatically when the bucket is empty
autoTopup.readOnly: An owner or admin can change auto top-up.
autoTopup.invalidBlocks: Enter a whole number of blocks from 1 to 100.
autoTopup.failed: Auto top-up could not be saved. Try again.
autoTopup.savedCardUnlabelled: charged to the saved payment method
autoTopup.noCard: no saved payment method — your next purchase saves one, and auto top-up runs from then on

attempt.none: No auto top-up has run this month.
attempt.open: Last top-up {date}: open, its invoice is under Invoices

purchase.title: Buy governed action units
purchase.wholeBlocks: Choose a whole number of blocks to see the total
purchase.savesCard: Checkout saves your card; auto top-up runs from then on
purchase.denied: An owner or a billing member can buy governed action units.

errors.invalid: Choose a whole number of blocks.
errors.aboveMax: You can buy at most {max} GAU at once.
errors.denied: Your role cannot buy governed action units. An owner or a billing member can.
errors.conflict: This organization is billed by invoice, so it does not buy units in blocks.
errors.unavailable: Checkout could not be opened. Nothing was charged.

usageCredits.title: Usage credits
usageCredits.basis: Credits pay for the in-app agent's model calls at provider cost times the published markup. 1 credit = $0.01.
usageCredits.exhausted: The in-app agent's platform-paid turns stop until a top-up lands.
usageCredits.denied: An owner or a billing member can top up usage credits.
usageCredits.planDenied: Usage credits need a Build plan or above. Subscribe first and the top-up opens here.

errors.invalid: Enter a whole dollar amount of at least ${min}.
errors.denied: Your role cannot top up usage credits. An owner or a billing member can.
errors.unavailable: Checkout could not be opened. Nothing was charged.

whatCounts.title: What counts
whatCounts.creditsBody: each model call the in-app agent makes, at provider cost times the meter markup.
whatCounts.freeBody: membership writes and every governed action other than resolve_approval.

changePlan.title: Change plan
changePlan.lede: Build and Scale are billed through Stripe Checkout, which shows the amount due before anything is charged.
changePlan.enterprise: Enterprise is negotiated per contract; its terms are set on your agreement, not here.
changePlan.denied: An owner or a billing member can change the plan.
changePlan.subscribed: This organization already has a {plan} subscription. Changing an existing subscription is not in the app yet: it would swap the plan in Stripe from the next renewal.

errors.invalid: Choose a plan and how it is billed.
errors.denied: Your role cannot change the plan. An owner or a billing member can.
errors.conflict: This organization already has an active subscription, so Checkout cannot start a second one.
errors.unavailable: Checkout could not be opened. Nothing was charged.

failure.denied: You cannot see {section} for this organization. Your role does not include {permission}; an organization owner can grant it.
failure.pendingApproval: Access to {section} is waiting for approval, request {accessRequestId}.
failure.error: {section} could not be loaded: the billing service answered {code}. Nothing was charged.
